description: Redesign Site3 (Catan board game fan page) CSS and HTML to be professional, mature, and highly readable while preserving all content. Replace childish/playful styling with a warm but sophisticated design inspired by Site1's professional patterns.
steps: Replace Google Fonts in site3/index.html: swap Fredoka + Nunito for a professional combination like Inter (body) + Playfair Display (headings), matching Site1's approach
Rewrite site3/style.css to use CSS custom properties (variables) for colors, spacing, shadows, and border-radius - following Site1's :root pattern

Implement a warm but sophisticated color palette: warm neutral backgrounds (not bright cream), earth-tone accents (deep terracotta, forest green, warm gold) with proper contrast ratios for readability

Replace the hero section: remove animated gradient background and floating hexagons, use a clean centered design with subtle background like Site1's glass-morphism hero card or a simple warm gradient that doesn't animate wildly
Redesign card components: reduce border-radius from 20px to 12px, add subtle borders (1px solid var(--border)), use translateY(-4px) hover instead of scale/rotate, remove excessive shadows
Fix the resource tiles: remove rotate hover effect, use clean bordered cards with subtle background tints instead of vivid solid backgrounds
Redesign the How to Play steps: keep the numbered steps but use bordered cards with accent left-border (like Site1's timeline cards) instead of colored circle numbers, remove translateX hover
Redesign editions grid: use proper cards with top gradient bars (like Site1's stat-card::before pattern) instead of bottom colored borders, improve typography sizing and readability
Replace stat bubbles: instead of vivid colored bubble backgrounds, use clean bordered stat cards with large numbers in accent color (matching Site1's stat-card pattern)
Remove sticky-note fun facts: replace rotated sticky notes with clean grid cards (like Site1's fact-card pattern) - no rotation transforms, proper border and padding, consistent backgrounds
Refine link buttons: keep pill shape but use bordered style with hover color fill (like Site1's social-btn pattern) instead of always-solid colored buttons
Fix footer: add a gradient separator line above footer content, improve spacing

Tone down all animations: remove float keyframe from avatar, reduce hero gradient animation (or remove it), make fadeInUp animation more subtle, ensure hover transitions are just translateY with shadow changes - no rotate or scale
Improve typography hierarchy: ensure h2 is at least 1.8rem, body text at least 1rem (not 0.85rem), proper line-height (1.7-1.8), adequate spacing between elements
Ensure responsive design still works: maintain the existing breakpoints but update them for the new card/grid designs, ensure mobile readability is excellent
Add reduced-motion media query that properly disables all animations for accessibility
acceptance_criteria: All Catan content (About, Resources, How to Play, Editions, Stats, Fun Facts, Links) is preserved exactly as before
No JavaScript is used - pure HTML + CSS only
Typography uses professional fonts (Inter/Playfair Display or similar professional pair) with minimum 1rem body text
Color palette is warm and sophisticated - no bright orange/yellow dominant hero, no vivid stat bubbles
No rotating, bouncing, or floating animations on page elements - only subtle fade-in and translateY hover effects
Fun facts section uses clean cards instead of rotated sticky notes
All text has good contrast ratios (dark text on light backgrounds, or white text on sufficiently dark backgrounds)
Cards have consistent styling: 12px border-radius, subtle borders, translateY hover effects
Responsive design works at mobile (< 600px), tablet (600-900px), and desktop (> 900px) breakpoints
Page validates as valid HTML5 with no errors
verification: Visually inspect site3/index.html in a browser to confirm professional appearance
Check that all content sections are present and readable
Verify responsive behavior at different viewport widths
Confirm no JavaScript was added - only HTML and CSS changes
Check that hover effects are subtle (translateY) not playful (rotate/scale)
findings: Successfully redesigned Site3 from childish to professional. All content preserved. Used Site1 patterns: CSS custom properties, Inter+Playfair Display fonts, bordered cards with translateY hover, gradient top bars on hover, clean stat cards, fact cards grid. Removed all playful animations (floating hex, bouncing avatar, rotating sticky notes). No JavaScript. Responsive at all breakpoints. Reduced-motion media query included.
